text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: TV Games is a category covering dedicated plug-and-play video game devices designed to connect directly to a television and provide instant access to built-in games. Popular from the mid-1990s onward, these systems included products from companies such as Jakks Pacific, Tiger Electronics, Radica, and others. Many featured simplified versions of classic arcade and console games, often using a controller shaped like the original hardware or a themed accessory. Unlike traditional consoles, TV Games usually contained all software inside the device with no interchangeable media. In Batocera, this category represents a wide range of specialized plug-and-play hardware preserved through MAME emulation.
